founder.name: María José Figueroa
bio: María José is a systems thinker, transformational consultant, and regenerative business strategist with deep experience in human-centered organizational design.

After years working with growth-stage startups, she witnessed firsthand how rapid scaling and misaligned structures led to burnout, culture breakdowns, and leadership drift — even in purpose-driven companies.
COIREA was born from this observation: organizations need more than better processes. They need a complete reimagining of how work, leadership, and purpose come together.
Trained in conscious leadership, somatic practices, and regenerative design, María José brings a holistic approach that integrates strategic consulting with soul-deep inquiry.
She has guided leadership teams, coached founders, and facilitated retreats for companies navigating complexity, culture transformation, and intentional growth.
founder.quote: The future belongs to organizations that can hold both structure and soul, efficiency and essence. We're here to help you build that.
